cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - RoundedTrapezoidBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Trapezoid box with rounded vertical edges.
The x and y measurements are for a trapazoid with sharp corners. The radii cut the corners so the actual width is smaller for all trapazoids except rectangles.
![Two boxes side by side](static/samples/RoundedTrapezoidBox-2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes RoundedTrapezoidBox --x_front 140 --x_back 90 --y 110 --h 70 --radius_front_left 10 --radius_front_right 30 --radius_back_right 5 --radius_back_left 15 --top lid --wall_pieces 2 --thickness 4 --burn 0.15 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes RoundedTrapezoidBox --x_front --x_back --y --h --radius_front_left --radius_front_right --radius_back_right --radius_back_left --top --wall_pieces --thickness --burn --reference --labels
